title: Ex-Fins OLB Chubb gets 3-year deal with Bills

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Ex-Fins OLB Chubb gets 3-year deal with Bills
sources.description: Pass rusher Bradley Chubb reached agreement on a three-year, $43.5 million deal worth up to $52.5 million that includes $29 million guaranteed with the Bills, agent Erik Burkhardt told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
